title: Photo analysis result
description: Observations about one listing photograph. Measurement and legal fields are deliberately absent: FR-007 forbids AI from originating them, and a schema that cannot express them cannot be talked into one.

roomType.description: Must match the public.room_type enum in 0006_media.sql.

confidence.description: Confidence in roomType. Surfaced to the agent so they can tell which classifications to check.

featureTags.description: Visible features only. Never a measurement, a material claim that cannot be verified from an image, or anything about people.

contentFlags.description: Things the agent must resolve before publishing. A closed set so a flag cannot be invented in free text and then missed by the review screen.

altText.description: Accessible description of the photograph. Describes the space, never the people in it.

coverRecommended.description: Whether this would make a good cover photo. A recommendation only; the agent chooses (Principle I).

recommendationReason.description: Why, in one sentence, so the agent can judge the recommendation instead of trusting it.
